# CyDoc

> Modular, multilingual, MIT-licensed application documentation, readable from local files without a web server. These guides describe the current 0.1.0 implementation.

Exports open through `Documentation.html`; their scripts, media and manifests are contained in `DocData/`.
The reader is for human users. Assistant guidance belongs in the separate `DocAI.md` sidecar, outside navigation and search. Publish secondary languages only when all public content is translated.

## Guides for AI coding assistants

- [Start here](ai/README.md): scope, integration choices and verification.
- [Integration](ai/INTEGRATION.md): consume a local package, build an offline manual and open contextual help.
- [Update requirements](ai/UPDATE.md): human manual, English/French, private build workspace, tree navigation and API-only references.
- [Authoring](ai/AUTHORING.md): page templates, translations, code extraction, media and diagrams.
- [API reference](ai/API.md): core, viewer and optional module contracts.
- [Studio](ai/STUDIO.md): separate web/Windows authoring, authenticated SDK/MCP and optional Git.
- [Standalone showcase convention](ai/showcase/README.md): self-contained English guide and complete local CyDoc example with its own screenshots, scripts, styles and real offline HTML manual; no external reference links, Git/GitHub optional.

- [README convention](ai/readme/README.md): native three-column GitHub header with visible borders, version/stage notes, clear installation/build sections, dependency licenses, optional attribution and final AI Usage links; includes a complete CyDoc example, [agent instructions](ai/readme/DocAI.md) and copyable [English](ai/readme/TEMPLATE.md)/[French](ai/readme/TEMPLATE.fr.md) structure templates. Check actual GitHub rendering before claiming visual fidelity.

## Project references

- [README](README.md): status, features, commands and limitations.
- [Repository agent instructions](AGENTS.md): guidance for editing the CyDoc checkout.
- [Structured API examples](examples/api/README.md): Doxygen, TypeDoc and neutral interchange format.
